metadata.SimNote: doc/three-tips.md: the pair. This half waits by the SCORING FLOWER with a turret, fires 8 as the LEFT CELL comes up, then the WALL FLOWER's 4 at the RIGHT CELL; as saved it runs with Belding's own accuracy and feed, and the what-if knobs in doc/three-tips.md 'How it was run' give the tables
